title: Parse a simple sectioned configuration
prompt: The configuration reader needs to support section headers, ignore comment lines, and return keys under their section. A configuration with a comment and two sections is currently parsed incorrectly.
setup: The workspace contains a small standard-library Python module named solution.py. Do not use network access or install dependencies.

source.basis: Small pure-Python utility patterns from packages/ (configuration, validation, limits, and file handling); fixture is isolated from application services.
